ns2:course.label: CAS Project
ns2:course.description: (LIS 459) Individual study of a problem in library or information science; forms the culmination of the Certificate of Advanced Study program. May be repeated. Only eight will apply to the Certificate of Advanced Study. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Admission to Certificate of Advanced Study program in library and information science; submision of "Request to Enroll in LIS 593 - CAS Project" form.
